canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Gateway First Bank denied {value} of its 1,973 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Gateway First Bank decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Gateway First Bank will deny any specific future application with 7.7% probability
Gateway First Bank is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Gateway First Bank discriminates or violates law
7.7% applies to Gateway First Bank's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
